title: Twitter Tools
intro: I am an active Twitter user and as such I am always looking for new tools that will improve my efficiency and use of Twitter. Below is a short list of tools that I use and recommend.

tools.name: BackTweets
tools.description: Trace a link to see where it travels, who links to and mentions it, and the conversation around it.

tools.name: TweetDeck (now X Pro)
tools.description: A multi-column Twitter client that lets you interact and converse on Twitter more efficiently.

outro: While this isn't a complete list of tools, it is some of the best I have found. If you have additional suggestions, message me on Twitter
